questions.question: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 12 days: B and C together can complete it in 15 days. If A is twice as good a workman as C, in how many days will A alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Let x, y and z be the number of days taken by A, B and C respectively to complete the work.

Since A is twice as efficient as C, z = 2x ---- (1)

A and B finish the work in 12 days, so

1/x + 1/y = 1/12 ---- (2)

B and C can together finish the work in 15 days, so

1/y + 1/z = 1/15 ---- (3)

(2) – (3) gives us,

1/x – 1/z = 1/12 - 1/15

1/x – 1/2x = 1/60 (using z = 2x from (1))

1/2x = 1/60

x = 30.

Hence, A will take 30 days to complete the work.

**Alternate Solution:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b45215623aff3d333ef35a8f74bcd8b2c935a24efccad07fe355c750e65beae.png] 

Efficiency of (A + B) = 5

Efficiency of (B + C) = 4

Efficiency of (A + B - B - C) = 5 - 4

Efficiency of (A - C) = 1

Since A is twice as efficient as C.

⇒ A = 2C

⇒ 2C - C = 1

⇒ Efficiency of C = 1

⇒ Efficiency of A = 2 × 1 = 2

⇒ Time taken by A to complete the work = 60/2 = 30 days

questions.question: The mean of four numbers is 37. The mean of the smallest three of them is 34. If the range of the data is 15, what is the mean of the largest three?

The mean of four numbers x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄ = 37

The sum of four numbers x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄ = 37 × 4 = 148.

The mean of the smallest three numbers x₁, x₂, x₃ = 34

The sum of the smallest three numbers x₁, x₂, x₃ = 34 × 3 = 102.

∴ The value of the largest number x₄ = 148 – 102 = 46.

The Range (Difference between largest and smallest value) x₄ – x₁ = 15.

∴ Smallest number x₁ = 46 – 15 = 31.

Now,

The sum of x₂, x₃ = Total sum – (sum of smallest and largest number).

⇒ 148 – (46 + 31)

⇒ 148 – 77

⇒ 71

Now,

The mean of the Largest three numbers x₂, x₃, x₄ = (71 + 46)/3 = 117/3 = 3

questions.question:
A, B and C are waiting for three different-route buses. Who leaves second?

**Statements:**

1. A’s bus Departs first.

2. B is the last one to leave.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :

**Statement 1**: A’s bus Departs first.

No information is given about B or C. So, statement 1 is not sufficient.

**Statement 2**: B is the last one to leave.

No information is given about A or C. So, statement 2 is not sufficient.

**Combining both the statements:**

As A is first and B is last, C will be second.

Hence, Statement 1 and Statement 2 together are sufficient.

questions.question: The total sales of a small home based business earned a profit of 30,000 in the previous quarter and the current quarter the profit increased by 15% over the previous quarter. What is the actual profit in the current quarter?
questions.solution:
The profit earned in the previous quarter = Rs. 30,000.

The percentage of profit increased in the current quarter = 15%

The profit increase in the current quarter = 15% of 30000

⇒ (15 ÷ 100) × 30000

⇒ Rs. 4500

The Actual profit earned in the current quarter = 30000 + 4500

⇒ Rs. 34500

questions.question: To an astronaut in space, the sky appears to be ______.
questions.solution:
Option **4** is correct i.e __**black,**__

__
 
• The sky appears **black**__ to an astronaut because there is no atmosphere in outer space that can scatter the sunlight.
 
• As **sunlight does not scatter in space, **no scatter light reaches the eyes of the astronauts and the sky appears black to them.
 
• **Light can travel through space because it is an EM(electromagnetic) wave**, but the scattering will not take place because of the lack of atmosphere.
